rules.semantic_labels: Normalize only decorative edge whitespace; match the complete semantic title.
rules.foreground_scope: Resolve the current foreground container and element type before reading or acting.
rules.unique_reads_and_actions: Both passive reads and actions use one foreground-scoped match. Observations need a visible frame; actions additionally require enabled/hittable. Never pick the first duplicate.
rules.live_state: Require the expected live data or completed transition. Placeholder, redaction, and element existence alone do not establish readiness.
rules.keyboard_and_scroll: Use shared keyboard and reveal handling; retain explicit postconditions for optional transient UI.
rules.environment: Check actual fixtures, services, onboarding and dependencies, including simulator team/App ID/bundle consistency and the remote consumer’s shared-data context, before long UI work.
rules.first_failure_evidence: Compare hierarchy, recording and coordinates before changing an interaction; capture remote-process logs during the test because runner cleanup can stop its simulator; retain bounded persistent probes and repair missing diagnostics before another attempt.
rules.failure_classification: Separate app defects, harness defects, environment failures and inspection failures; count repeat attempts.
rules.runtime_warnings: A passed assertion does not dispose of application runtime warnings.
rules.device_evidence: Simulator checks do not prove actual audio, notification delivery, re-signing or device permissions.
